name: @restregular/dsh-notepad
description: Notepad — a per-workspace floating notepad in the DeepSeek Harness session view with a dedicated settings tab (themes, flat / frosted-glass surfaces, fonts, save mode, AI prompt presets, button groups, hover delay, card height and geometry defaults), plugin undo / redo that never overrides textarea history, collapsible segments with batch select / archive / delete / copy, an AI improve that switches to the selected text and re-selects it after rewriting, newest-first archives with auto-scroll, a workspace dropdown limited to workspaces with note content, oldest-first segment cards with click-to-edit titles, Enter split, Backspace merge, drag reorder, arrow-key navigation, delayed hover action groups with distinct new-session insert / send icons, in-panel image previews, rotating shortcut tips, busy-send policy, image cleanup, pending badges, scroll-safe auto refresh and dark-mode styling. · 记事本 — 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话界面显示一个按工作区共享的分段便签浮窗，并新增「记事本」设置页：配色主题、纯色扁平 / 可调模糊的毛玻璃、字体字号、自动 / 手动保存、撤销步数、按钮组与 hover 阈值、AI 提示词预设、分段最大高度、默认位置尺寸。插件提供撤销 / 重做（输入框仍用原生撤销），分段可折叠，支持批量选择、归档、删除与复制；选中文字时 AI 只优化选中部分并在完成后重新选中；归档按最新在上并自动滚动；顶部工作区改为下拉列表，只列出有记事本内容的工作区，点击切换到该工作区的新会话；插入 / 发送的新会话图标相互区分；图片不显示名称，删除按钮位于缩略图右上角；分段进出都有过渡动画，自动保存不再把列表滚回顶部。
author: RestRegular
